objective: Test a zero-parameter single-boundary structural rule for Side-to-Opposite-Side proposals on the confirmation cohort kept unopened by the preceding transition-family development experiment.

lineage.transition_family_development_observatio: Draw-to-Side was extremely rare; Side-to-Opposite-Side carried aggregate positive signal but was unstable across folds/groups. This observation motivates mechanism localization only; no numeric cutoff is derived.

data.cleanliness_guard: The preceding transition-family Artifact contains confirm_unopened.txt and no confirmation data receipt; therefore this exact cohort was not downloaded or scored in that experiment.

mechanism.SIDE_TO_SIDE_reference: opening Top1 is H or A and closing Top1 is the opposite H/A side
mechanism.RUNNERUP_SINGLE_BOUNDARY_candidate: execute a SIDE_TO_SIDE proposal only if its closing target was rank-2 under opening probabilities. Equivalently, opening probability of target must be strictly greater than opening draw probability. If target was rank-3, the proposal crosses both draw and the old Top1 and is blocked. Ties are blocked.
mechanism.DRAW_TO_SIDE: excluded from candidate and SIDE_TO_SIDE comparator; this experiment isolates direct H-vs-A reversal structure
mechanism.ALL_SIDE_reference: all H/A-target proposals including Draw-to-Side and Side-to-Side, reported only as context
mechanism.weak_floor: P_weak_after >= P_weak_before; otherwise exact opening fallback

interpretation_guards: This proxy does not add market inputs to any football3 model.
A pass would establish only an externally supported structural hypothesis for future genuinely fresh Big-5 confirmation.
A fail consumes this confirmation cohort and forbids threshold, rank, league, team or fold rescue on it.
The quarantined 2026/27 Big-5 97-match snapshot remains unopened.
